events.evidence: A shaky truce is broken with police and protesters renewing clashes on Kyiv's Maidan Nezalezhnosti, with scores of deaths reported
The European Union imposes sanctions against Ukraine including asset freezes and visa bans
Egyptian security officials say army helicopter gunships have rocketed several houses where militants were thought to have gathered in the northern region of the Sinai Peninsula, killing at least 10

label.note: Deadly Kyiv clashes and EU sanctions drive sharp risk-off; Sinai violence adds to geopolitics.
